verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe an 'Agent Tasks' feature on GitHub Mobile giving developers a centralized way to start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks from their phone, directly matching the story. However, all community evidence predates this feature and concerns general app bugs/UX, so there's no independent corroboration of the agent-task management experience itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the agent-tasks feature, and detail on depth of task control (e.g., cancelling, reassigning) beyond marketing copy.
